subject: Daily AcreetionOS Update -- August 26, 2026
body:
**AcreetionOS 1.0 Released: Cinnamon XL (XLibre)**

We are thrilled to announce the release of AcreetionOS 1.0, featuring the Cinnamon XL (XLibre) edition! This milestone marks a significant achievement for our community-driven project, offering a lightweight, privacy-focused Linux distribution based on Arch Linux. The Cinnamon XL (XLibre) edition provides a sleek and efficient desktop experience, perfect for those seeking a hassle-free, customizable, and secure operating system.

**Community News**

* The AcreetionOS community has been actively contributing to the project, with several community members participating in the development process and providing valuable feedback.
* We're grateful for the support and enthusiasm from our community, which has helped shape AcreetionOS into a robust and user-friendly distribution.
* The AcreetionOS Discord server is a great place to connect with fellow users, ask questions, and share knowledge. Join us at [https://discord.acreetionos.org](https://discord.acreetionos.org).

**Practical Tip**

* To ensure seamless updates and security patches, make sure to regularly check for updates in your AcreetionOS system. You can do this by running the following command in your terminal: `sudo pacman -Syu`. This will update your system to the latest version, keeping your AcreetionOS installation secure and up-to-date.

Stay tuned for more updates, and thank you for being part of the AcreetionOS community!
